confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of London prices, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and pub anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July demand is high and rates vary widely. The FX observation came from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA overview page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Western European capitals with high accommodation costs in peak summer (for example Paris and Amsterdam), adjusted to London's pub and restaurant norms and converted at roughly 1.33 USD per GBP.
